_doc: Settings of the Kelin catalogue mirror (s51, 2026-11-23). Copied to ops/mirror-config.json in the mirror by scripts/sync-dataset-mirror.sh; read by build.py, hf-sync.py, zenodo.py. data_license: null | "CC-BY-4.0" | "CC0-1.0" — null: the owner answered "no" to an open licence (2026-11-23; the CC-BY-4.0 setting of that day is withdrawn); null = no licence statement anywhere, and the Zenodo / Hugging Face steps refuse to run. zenodo.concept_doi: written by zenodo.py writeback after the first Zenodo-archived release. huggingface.repo_id: <user-or-org>/<name>, set once the user has created the account / organisation. repo / branch / gist: the only targets the scripts may write to (pinned again in mirror_check.py PINNED; a different value is refused). wayback.local_first_pass: true while the first whole-site Wayback pass runs from the laptop (scripts/wayback-after-deploy.sh) — the weekly job and a normal sync then skip their Wayback step; set false once the local pass reports complete. wayback.checkpoint: the one shared Wayback log (in the mirror repository) that both the weekly job and the local runs read and append to.
